questions.text: Raju obtained 75 and 85 marks in mathematics and physics, respectively. Find the marks he must get in chemistry to have an average of 80 marks in all the three subjects.

A, B, C, D, P, Q and R are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. Only two people sit between R and D when counted from the left of D. P sits third to the left of B. Q sits to the immediate right of B. Q sits second to the left of R. C is not an immediate neighbour of P. Who sits third to the right of A?

In the beginning, both builder and destroyer were set to work together on a basic level. But after 15 hours the destroyer was withdrawn. What was the total time (in hours) taken to build the wall?
